notes.title: Second Shift Demo Is Now Available – Play Now on Steam!
notes.content:
The demo for *Second Shift* is now available on Steam!

Step into a world filled with horror, mystery, and tension. This short playable demo gives you a glimpse of what awaits in the full release.

🎮 What’s in the demo?
- A brief look at the main story
- Chilling environments and atmospheric horror
- Early gameplay mechanics and puzzles

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us! Don’t forget to share your experience in the community and **add the game to your wishlist** if you enjoy it.

Happy gaming!
